import sys, os, time, hashlib
sys.dont_write_bytecode = True
for k in ['OPENROUTER_API_KEY', 'PLACE_MODEL']: os.environ.pop(k, None)
from types import ModuleType
from collections import Counter
from itertools import product
from unittest.mock import Mock, patch
sys.path.insert(0, '/root/worktrees/send-c1b/backend')
from dealroom_sign import placement as _p
from dealroom_sign.tests.test_placement_r14 import in_process
from dealroom_sign.tests import placement_r24_review_cases as R24
rc = R24.rc
live = open('/root/worktrees/send-merge/backend/dealroom_sign/placement.py').read()
assert hashlib.sha256(live.encode()).hexdigest().startswith('866637df')
SRC = dict(r29=live, r31=open(_p.__file__).read())
assert hashlib.sha256(SRC['r31'].encode()).hexdigest().startswith('a8ad8dcc')
def mk(n):
    m = ModuleType('own_' + n); m.__file__ = _p.__file__; sys.modules[m.__name__] = m
    exec(compile(SRC[n], m.__name__, 'exec'), m.__dict__); return m
M = {n: mk(n) for n in SRC}
http = Mock(side_effect=AssertionError('http')); calls = Counter()
NOWHERE = (99, 0, 0, 0)
PE, DE, CE = rc.PE, rc.DE, 'chris@harborlight.fleet.test'
HLA = 'HARBOR LIGHT ANALYTICS, INC.'
REC = dict(rc.RECITALS)
REC['aff'] = [(80, 'This Agreement is entered into between HARBOR LIGHT HOLDINGS, LLC ("Discloser") and HARBOR LIGHT ANALYTICS, INC. ("Recipient").', False, 40)]
REC['swapped'] = [(80, 'This Agreement is entered into between FLEET TEST CO. ("Recipient") and HARBOR LIGHT ANALYTICS, INC. ("Discloser").', False, 40)]
REC['abbr'] = [(80, 'This Agreement is entered into between FLEET TEST CO. ("Discloser") and HARBOR LIGHT ANALYTICS, INC. ("HLA").', False, 40)]

def blk(role, head, x, y, p, w=200):
    rows = []
    if role: rows.append((y - 50, role, False, x))
    if head: rows.append((y - 38, head, False, x))
    return rows + [(y, 'By:', True, x, x + w), (y + p, 'Date:', True, x, x + w)]

def nm(form, who, x, y):
    return {'name': [(y, f'Name: {who}', False, x)], 'bare': [(y, who, False, x)],
            'role': [(y, f'{who}, CEO', False, x)]}[form]

def pat(kind):
    return {'domain': dict(name='Pat Smith', email=PE),
            'explicit': dict(name='Pat Smith', email=PE, company='Harbor Light Analytics, Inc.')}[kind]
DAN = dict(name='Dan Whaley', email=DE, company='Fleet Test Co.')

def cases(fam):
    for p, g, form in product((24, 30, 40), (24, 30, 36, 44, 50), ('name', 'bare', 'role')):
        Y = 200; D = Y + p; NY = D + g
        if fam == 'misspell':
            # Pat's own block under a misspelled / abbreviated heading; Fleet unnamed on the right.
            for head, rec, sk, right in product(
                    ('HARBOR LITE ANALYTICS, INC.', 'HLA, INC.', 'HARBOR LIGHT, INC.', 'HARBORLIGHT ANALYTICS INC.',
                     'HARBOUR LIGHT ANALYTICS, INC.', 'H.L. ANALYTICS, INC.', 'HLA:', 'Harbor Light Analytics'),
                    ('parsed', 'none', 'abbr'), ('domain', 'explicit', 'both'), (False, True)):
                rows = blk(None, head, 72, Y, p) + nm(form, 'Pat Smith', 72, NY)
                allowed = {PE: (2, 72, Y, 272), DE: NOWHERE}
                if right:
                    rows += blk('DISCLOSER:', 'FLEET TEST CO.', 340, Y, p, 200); allowed[DE] = (2, 340, Y, 540)
                people = [DAN, pat('domain')] if sk == 'both' else [pat(sk)]
                yield (fam, head, rec, sk, right), [REC[rec], rows], people, allowed
        elif fam == 'misspell_sender':
            # Sender block (nameless) whose heading misspells / abbreviates Pat's company is impossible
            # to tell apart; instead: sender heading is Fleet, and Pat's block is a misspelled heading on the right.
            for head, rec, sk in product(('HARBOR LITE ANALYTICS, INC.', 'HLA, INC.', 'HARBOR LIGHT, INC.', 'HARBOUR LIGHT ANALYTICS, INC.'),
                                         ('parsed', 'none', 'abbr'), ('domain', 'explicit')):
                rows = blk('DISCLOSER:', 'FLEET TEST CO.', 72, Y, p) + nm(form, 'Pat Smith', 72, NY) + blk(None, head, 340, Y, p)
                yield (fam, head, rec, sk), [REC[rec], rows], [pat(sk)], {PE: (2, 340, Y, 540)}
        elif fam == 'role_other':
            # Role-only heading whose recital maps to the other party.
            for top, rec, sk, other in product(('RECIPIENT:', 'DISCLOSER:', 'The Recipient:'), ('parsed', 'swapped'),
                                               ('domain', 'explicit', 'both'), ('none', 'right', 'below')):
                owner_is_hla = (top.endswith('Recipient:') or top == 'RECIPIENT:') == (rec == 'parsed')
                otherrole = 'DISCLOSER:' if 'ecipient' in top.lower() else 'RECIPIENT:'
                rows = blk(None, top, 72, Y, p) + nm(form, 'Pat Smith', 72, NY)
                allowed = {PE: (2, 72, Y, 272) if owner_is_hla else NOWHERE, DE: NOWHERE if owner_is_hla else (2, 72, Y, 272)}
                if other == 'right':
                    rows += blk(None, otherrole, 340, Y, p)
                    allowed[DE if owner_is_hla else PE] = (2, 340, Y, 540)
                elif other == 'below':
                    rows += blk(None, otherrole, 72, 500, 30)
                    allowed[DE if owner_is_hla else PE] = (2, 72, 500, 272)
                people = [DAN, pat('domain')] if sk == 'both' else [pat(sk)]
                yield (fam, top, rec, sk, other, owner_is_hla), [REC[rec], rows], people, allowed
            # Role heading maps to HLA but the printed name is the sender's.
            for rec, other in product(('parsed', 'none'), ('none', 'right')):
                rows = blk(None, 'RECIPIENT:', 72, Y, p) + nm(form, 'Dan Whaley', 72, NY)
                allowed = {DE: NOWHERE}
                if other == 'right':
                    rows += blk(None, 'DISCLOSER:', 340, Y, p); allowed[DE] = (2, 340, Y, 540)
                yield (fam, 'RECIPIENT:dan', rec, 'dan', other, False), [REC[rec], rows], [DAN], allowed
        elif fam == 'same_company':
            CHRIS = dict(name='Chris Doe', email=CE)
            for shape, rec, who in product(('pat_top_chris_right_named', 'chris_top_pat_below_noheading',
                                            'chris_top_pat_below_headed', 'pat_top_chris_right_blank',
                                            'chris_top_named_elsewhere'),
                                           ('parsed', 'none'), ('pat', 'both', 'pat_explicit')):
                people = {'pat': [pat('domain')], 'both': [pat('domain'), CHRIS],
                          'pat_explicit': [pat('explicit'), dict(CHRIS, company='Harbor Light Analytics, Inc.')]}[who]
                rows = blk(None, HLA, 72, Y, p) + nm(form, 'Pat Smith', 72, NY)
                if shape == 'pat_top_chris_right_named':
                    rows += blk(None, HLA, 340, Y, p) + [(D + 14, 'Name: Chris Doe', False, 340)]
                    allowed = {PE: (2, 72, Y, 272), CE: (2, 340, Y, 540)}
                elif shape == 'pat_top_chris_right_blank':
                    rows += blk(None, HLA, 340, Y, p)
                    allowed = {PE: (2, 72, Y, 272), CE: (2, 340, Y, 540)}
                elif shape == 'chris_top_pat_below_noheading':
                    yb = NY + 44
                    rows += [(yb, 'By:', True, 72, 272), (yb + 30, 'Date:', True, 72, 272)]
                    allowed = {PE: (2, 72, yb, 272), CE: (2, 72, Y, 272)}
                elif shape == 'chris_top_pat_below_headed':
                    yb = 560
                    rows += blk(None, HLA, 72, yb, 30)
                    allowed = {PE: (2, 72, yb, 272), CE: (2, 72, Y, 272)}
                else:
                    # Chris's top block, Pat Smith printed in band is a stray; Pat's real block next page.
                    allowed = {PE: (3, 72, 200, 272), CE: (2, 72, Y, 272)}
                    pages = [REC[rec], rows, blk(None, HLA, 72, 200, 30) + [(244, 'Name: Pat Smith', False, 72)]]
                    yield (fam, shape, rec, who), pages, people, allowed
                    continue
                yield (fam, shape, rec, who), [REC[rec], rows], people, allowed
        elif fam == 'affiliate_sender':
            # Sender's heading names the counterparty's affiliate; Pat's name in the band belongs elsewhere.
            for head, rec, sk, pblock in product(('HARBOR LIGHT HOLDINGS, LLC', 'HARBOR LIGHT GROUP, INC.', 'HARBOR LIGHT CAPITAL, LLC',
                                                  'HARBOR LIGHT PARTNERS, LLC', 'HARBORLIGHT, LLC', 'HARBOR LIGHT ANALYTICS HOLDINGS, LLC'),
                                                 ('parsed', 'none', 'aff'), ('domain', 'explicit', 'both'),
                                                 ('none', 'next_page_headed', 'next_page_role', 'below_noheading', 'right_headed', 'next_page_named')):
                rows = blk('DISCLOSER:', head, 72, Y, p) + nm(form, 'Pat Smith', 72, NY)
                pages = [REC[rec], rows]; allowed = {PE: NOWHERE, DE: (2, 72, Y, 272)}
                if pblock == 'next_page_headed':
                    pages.append(blk('RECIPIENT:', HLA, 72, 200, 30)); allowed[PE] = (3, 72, 200, 272)
                elif pblock == 'next_page_role':
                    pages.append(blk(None, 'RECIPIENT:', 72, 200, 30)); allowed[PE] = (3, 72, 200, 272)
                elif pblock == 'next_page_named':
                    pages.append(blk(None, None, 72, 200, 30)); allowed[PE] = (3, 72, 200, 272)
                elif pblock == 'below_noheading':
                    yb = NY + 44
                    rows += [(yb, 'By:', True, 72, 272), (yb + 30, 'Date:', True, 72, 272)]; allowed[PE] = (2, 72, yb, 272)
                elif pblock == 'right_headed':
                    rows += blk('RECIPIENT:', HLA, 340, Y, p); allowed[PE] = (2, 340, Y, 540)
                people = [DAN, pat('domain')] if sk == 'both' else [pat(sk)]
                yield (fam, head, rec, sk, pblock), pages, people, allowed
        elif fam == 'prev_column':
            # Name printed under the left column's heading region, while the date-first block is to its right
            # or the reverse; and two-row column grids.
            for layout, rec, sk, nx in product(('fleet_left_hla_right', 'hla_left_fleet_right', 'grid'),
                                               ('parsed', 'none'), ('domain', 'explicit', 'both'), (72, 150, 250, 300, 340)):
                if layout == 'fleet_left_hla_right':
                    rows = blk(None, 'FLEET TEST CO.', 72, Y, p) + blk(None, HLA, 340, Y, p)
                    allowed = {PE: (2, 340, Y, 540), DE: (2, 72, Y, 272)}
                elif layout == 'hla_left_fleet_right':
                    rows = blk(None, HLA, 72, Y, p) + blk(None, 'FLEET TEST CO.', 340, Y, p)
                    allowed = {PE: (2, 72, Y, 272), DE: (2, 340, Y, 540)}
                    nx = {72: 340, 150: 380, 250: 300, 300: 250, 340: 200}[nx]  # name drifts toward the other column
                else:
                    # Top row: HLA left, Fleet right (both nameless); second row has Pat's name over Fleet's column
                    rows = blk(None, 'FLEET TEST CO.', 72, Y, p) + blk(None, HLA, 340, Y, p)
                    rows += blk(None, 'FLEET TEST CO.', 72, 520, 30)
                    allowed = {PE: (2, 340, Y, 540), DE: (2, 72, Y, 272)}
                rows += nm(form, 'Pat Smith', nx, NY)
                people = [DAN, pat('domain')] if sk == 'both' else [pat(sk)]
                yield (fam, layout, rec, sk, nx), [REC[rec], rows], people, allowed
        else:
            raise KeyError(fam)

fam = sys.argv[1]
G = Counter(); EX = Counter(); WS = []; t = time.time()
with patch('httpx.Client.send', http):
    for key, pages, people, allowed in cases(fam):
        pdf = rc.pages_pdf(pages); k = ''; got = {}
        for n, m in M.items():
            mo = Mock(); r = in_process(m, pdf, people, mo); calls[n] += mo.call_count
            w = rc.wrong_fields(r, allowed)
            k += 'W' if w else ('p' if r['fields'] else 'n')
            got[n] = sorted({(f['signer'][:3], f['page'], tuple(f['evidence']['line'])) for f in r['fields']})
        G[(key[1], k)] += 1
        if k[0] != k[1] or 'W' in k:
            EX[(k,) + key[1:]] += 1
            if len(WS) < 25 and ('W' in k or k == 'np'): WS.append((k, key, got['r31']))
print(fam, 'http', http.call_count, 'model', dict(calls), 'elapsed', round(time.time() - t), 'cells', sum(G.values()))
print('totals', sorted(Counter(k for (_, k) in G.elements()).items()))
for item in sorted(G.items(), key=str): print(' ', item)
for e, c in sorted(EX.items(), key=str): print('EX', c, e)
for w in WS: print('S', w)
